about: Gentle prompts shown in the empty writing box on the Today screen. One is picked per day. Edit freely: any text in double quotes, separated by commas.
prompts: What would you want to remember?
What was the best small thing today?
What did you eat, and was it good?
Who did you think about today?
What song kept playing in your head?
What are you tired of, or proud of?
Describe today in three words, then keep going.
